New applications on transportation emerge abundantly, contributing to the fact that people's lifestyle has been changed as well. The changes in the way of transportation can be listed as follows. First of all, the mobile phones can "tickets". We can take the bus or subway by scanning the QR code or simply swiping our mobile phones. In many places around China, dumplings are also a significant dish, because they symbolize wealth and good luck. 【分句解析】 此次翻译所考内容与中国人吃团圆饭的传统有关。 1. 第一句中的“做某事是某人的传统”可译力 It is/has been a tradition for sb. to do sth. 句型； “春节”可译力the Spring Festival 或 Chinese New Year，因此“春节前夕”可译为 on the eve of the Spring Festival EX on Chinese New Year's Eve. 2. 第二句翻译时既可以像参考译文那样处理为一个整句，也可拆译两句。拆译时，可将后半句“家人生活在不同地方的家庭尤其如此”译为 This is especially true for families whose members live in different places；“最佳时机”可译 the best/perfect time/moment。 3. 第三句中的“其中有些菜肴”中的“其”指代前半句提到的“团圆饭上的菜肴”，翻译时可将后半句处理非限制性定语从句，即 some of which⋯；“团圆饭上的菜肴”可译 The dishes for the reunion dinner；“丰富多样”也可译 diverse/rich and varied； “有特殊含义”译 have/ bear/imply special meanings. 4. 第四句中的“例如”可译 For example 或 For instance；“不可缺少的”可译 indispensable/ necessary/essential；“因…⋯”也可译 because/for the reason that＋从句或 because of/on account of＋名词；“⋯⋯和⋯••⋯听上去一样”可译••…sound（s）like⋯•⋯或⋯…sound（s） ..•and••.•••sound the same. the same as•••••…*•• 5.第五句需要注意句中的因果逻辑关系。“佳肴”也可译 delicacy；“象征”可译 symbolize/ represent.
